$comment: Cases for the coverage map's colours: src/design-system/heat.ts and the plugin's Domain\Map_Colors. Each case calls `fn` with `args` and expects `expected`. heat's args are a region's count, the busiest region's count and the theme; mix's are two #rrggbb colours and how far from the first to the second. A tie at exactly .5 goes up in both languages; the cases a hair under .5 are the ones that tell Math.round() from PHP's round() before 8.4.

cases.name: no submissions: the empty colours, almost no fill
no submissions, dark
the only count there is: the top of the ramp
a busiest of none still gives a count its top
one submission of eight: the bottom of the ramp
one submission of eight, dark
between two stops
between two stops, dark
halfway between two stops: a channel exactly on .5 goes up
a channel a hair under .5 (184.49999999999997) goes down, as Math.round() takes it; PHP's round() before 8.4 took it up
an outline channel a hair under .5 (38.49999999999999) goes down
on a stop
a third of the way
just below the busiest
the busiest: the last stop
the busiest, dark
no way along: the first colour
all the way: the second colour
halfway: 127.5 goes up
